definitions.full: H4338. Mesha מֵישַׁע proper name, masculine ( deliverance ) — Mesha, king of Moab 2Kin 3:4 = משע MI 1 ; ᵐ5 Μωσα . — see Sm and So MI, 1886 Dl Sm lxxxv ff .
